# ESSEC Knowledge

> > Research insights from ESSEC Business School faculty on business, economics, leadership, and societal transformation.

ESSEC Knowledge publishes academic research and expert analysis from ESSEC Business School professors on contemporary challenges spanning artificial intelligence, corporate governance, sustainability, economic policy, and innovation. The platform bridges academic rigor with practical business insights, featuring contributions from leading faculty including Viviane De Beaufort, Hamid Bouchikhi, and others across European and global contexts.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence & Digital Transformation
- Corporate Governance & Board Diversity
- European Union & Brexit
- Economic Policy & Risk Analysis
- Sustainability & Corporate Accountability
- Leadership & Organizational Behavior
- Innovation & Entrepreneurship
- Technology-Society Interactions
- Gender Quotas & Women in Leadership
- COVID-19 Business Impact
- Luxury Brand Strategy
- Data Science & HR Analytics
- Private Equity & Finance
- Social Reporting & ESG

## Artificial Intelligence & Digital Transformation

- [ESSEC Knowledge Review: Artificial intelligence and the technological transformation](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/innovation/essec-artificial-intelligence-transformation.html): ESSEC professors analyze AI's societal impact and technological transformation
- [ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN HR MANAGEMENT: WHY NOT JUST FLIP A COIN?](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/leadership/AI-in-hr-management-why-not-just-flip-a-coin.html): Valery Yakubovich examines AI challenges in HR analytics and recruitment
- [On pause or over-consumed: the double life of media in the COVID-19 age](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/strategy/pause-overconsumed-double-life-media-covid-19.html): Judith Andres examines COVID-19's impact on media and cultural sectors

## Leadership & Governance

- [Angela Merkel or how high you can go with a low profile](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/leadership/angela-merkel-or-how-high-you-can-go-low-profile.html): Hamid Bouchikhi analyzes Merkel's non-charismatic leadership style
- [The Old Girls Club: Gender Quotas and Women as Role Models](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/sustainability/old-girls-club-gender-quotas-and-women-role-models.html): Junko Takagi on gender quotas and women's role models in European boards
- [Women on boards: State of affairs in France and Europe](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/leadership/women-boards-state-affairs-france-europe.html): Viviane de Beaufort analyzes gender equality on European corporate boards
- [Staying connected while working remotely](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/leadership/staying-connected-while-working-remotely.html): Anca Metiu on maintaining workplace connectivity during remote work

## Economy, Finance & Policy

- [Political Risk vs. Economic Policy Risk: Which one really matters?](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/economy-finance/political-risk-vs-economic-policy-risk-which-one-r.html): Pagliardi & Longin compare political vs economic risks in 32 countries
- [Brexit, so what?](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/economy-finance/brexit-so-what.html): Viviane De Beaufort examines Brexit's European implications and trade impacts
- [Three Big Questions Preoccupying Economists](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/economy-finance/three-questions-preoccupying-economists.html): Guillaume Chevillon reports on NBER's top economic policy concerns
- [Dying To Do A Deal](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/economy-finance/dying-do-deal.html): Arcot & Gaspar analyze aging private equity funds and buyout behavior
- [A Reclining Nude and a Soaring Market](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/economy-finance/reclining-nude-and-soaring-market.html): Stoyan Sgourev analyzes Modigliani auction and art market unpredictability

## Corporate Strategy & Brand Management

- [How Gucci Navigates the Transcontinental Luxury Divide](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/strategy/how-gucci-navigates-transcontinental-luxury-divide.html): Ashok Som examines Gucci's strategy across European & American markets
- [Sleeping beauties: How to transform your brand into legend – and sell](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/strategy/sleeping-beauties-how-transform-your-brand-legend-.html): Delphine Dion on reviving heritage brands through customer experience

## Sustainability & Corporate Responsibility

- [Should corporations be made accountable for risky behavior?](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/sustainability/should-corporations-be-made-accountable-for-risky-.html): Marie-Laure Djelic examines corporate accountability and limited liability issues
- [The origin story of a social reporting model](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/sustainability/origin-story-social-reporting-model.html): Zicari & Aldama develop Value Footprint social reporting methodology
- [3 Minutes to Improve the Effectiveness of Corporate Giving](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/sustainability/video-3-minutes-improve-effectiveness-corporate-gi.html): Anne-Claire Pache explains corporate philanthropy strategies in 3 minutes

## Innovation & Entrepreneurship

- [How to Steer a Controversial Innovation Towards Acceptance -- and Success](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/innovation/how-steer-controversial-innovation-towards-accepta.html): Bernard Leca uses Impressionism to explain innovation legitimacy strategies
- [Morocco: How Can We Promote True Entrepreneurship?](https://knowledge.essec.edu/en/innovation/how-can-we-promote-true-entrepreneurship-maghreb.html): Hamid Bouchikhi analyzes Morocco's entrepreneurial ecosystem challenges
